title: Autonomous spin-localization investigation of syringol phenoxy radical
difficulty_reasons: The molecular object and observables are fixed, but the agent must formulate an independent computational route and discriminate site-localization conclusions.
Validation of an open-shell stationary structure and population convention is required before drawing a bounded conclusion.

data.description: Self-contained XYZ for the 20-atom neutral doublet syringol phenoxy radical with explicit atom map in the file comment and task.

required_deliverables.description: Independent method, four site spin populations, ordering, conclusion and bounded-failure fields.
